title: Crypto, an Oral Essay

reader_summary.headline: In this special Innovation Overview episode from April 2021.
reader_summary.overview: In this special Innovation Overview episode from April 2021, the A16C crypto team and other experts take you from the ground-up of crypto and Web3. Today we have a special episode all about crypto that we present as a resource for people wanting to better understand what it is. This is an audio essay featuring hallway-style conversations with the A16Z crypto team, as well as outside experts.

thesis: This episode serves as an educational oral essay explaining the origins, mechanics, and future implications of cryptocurrency and Web3. It details the cryptographic challenges of creating digital money, the innovations of Bitcoin's proof-of-work consensus, and the broader potential for decentralized ownership and finance.
